stemMd: The equations $ax+6y=15$ and $4x+8y=20$ represent the same line. What is $a$?
explanationMd: The first equation is 3/4 of the second because 6/8=15/20=3/4. Therefore a=(3/4)4=3. All three coefficient ratios must agree.

distractorRationale.a: This does not preserve the common ratio 3/4.
distractorRationale.c: This confuses the ratio of the constants with a coefficient.
distractorRationale.d: This matches a coefficient from the other variable rather than scaling.
